tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Console background, near-black. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Widget cards, tables, drawers, the top nav bar. The default ground for all text tokens.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised or hovered rows, table header row, input fields, the slicer panel.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Pressed state, selected table row, skeleton loaders, tooltip ground.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card outlines, table cell rules. Decorative only: never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox outlines, secondary button border, focus-free control edges. Meets 3:1 on `canvas`, `surface-100`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, values, table cells. On `canvas`, `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-300`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, axis ticks, column headers, captions. 4.5:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholder text, empty-state hints. On `canvas`, `surface-100`, `surface-200` only.

tokens.name: lens
tokens.usage: Selection and action inside the console: links, checked boxes, on-toggles, the selected chart mark, the active tab underline. Deliberately monochrome (near-white on dark, near-black on light) so severity is the only colour in the data.

tokens.name: lens-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `lens` fills and links.

tokens.name: lens-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for active filter chips, selected quadrant, the active-filter ring's fill.

tokens.name: on-lens
tokens.usage: Text on `lens` fills (checked states, heat steps 4–5).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The console's signal amber: the logo mark, the live status LED, the active-view marker in the sidebar, primary buttons and the focus ring. Chrome only. Never used inside charts, tables or badges, where colour means severity.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the active sidebar item and the status strip's LOCAL pill.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `signal` fills (primary buttons).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the host/finding drawer.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Tooltip and chart-tooltip ground; text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline at 2px offset on every focusable control. Signal amber on dark themes; a darker amber on light (3:1+).

tokens.name: sev-critical
tokens.usage: Critical: CVSS 9.0–10.0, SLA 14 days. Badge dot, badge text on `sev-critical-soft`, chart series, heatmap cells. Always paired with the word 'Critical': critical and high differ mostly by hue. In `cvd` it moves to magenta and sits darker than High; in charts add the ◆ marker.

tokens.name: sev-high
tokens.usage: High: CVSS 7.0–8.9, SLA 30 days. Badge dot, badge text on `sev-high-soft`, chart series, heatmap cells. Always paired with the word 'High': critical and high differ mostly by hue.

tokens.name: sev-medium
tokens.usage: Medium: CVSS 4.0–6.9, SLA 90 days. Badge dot, badge text on `sev-medium-soft`, chart series, heatmap cells. Always paired with the word 'Medium': critical and high differ mostly by hue.

tokens.name: sev-low
tokens.usage: Low (cyan, kept clear of the brand blue): CVSS 0.1–3.9, SLA 180 days. Badge dot, badge text on `sev-low-soft`, chart series, heatmap cells. Always paired with the word 'Low': critical and high differ mostly by hue.

tokens.name: sev-info
tokens.usage: Info: CVSS 0.0, SLA 360 days. Badge dot, badge text on `sev-info-soft`, chart series, heatmap cells. Always paired with the word 'Info': critical and high differ mostly by hue.

tokens.name: sev-critical-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and chip ground for Critical; `sev-critical` text on it holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: sev-high-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and chip ground for High; `sev-high` text on it holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: sev-medium-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and chip ground for Medium; `sev-medium` text on it holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: sev-low-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and chip ground for Low; `sev-low` text on it holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: sev-info-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and chip ground for Info; `sev-info` text on it holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: SLA Met, Resolved, Verified Remediated, compliance ≥ 80%. Green in `dark`/`light`/`hc`; blue in `cvd` so it never pairs red-vs-green with `status-danger`. Always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: status-ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for Met / Resolved pills.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: SLA at risk (≤ 7 days left), compliance 50–79%, Pending Verification.

tokens.name: status-warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for at-risk pills.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: SLA Breached, compliance < 50%, New Introduced Risk, destructive buttons.

tokens.name: status-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for Breached pills and the danger banner.

tokens.name: threat-zeroday
tokens.usage: Zero-day tag and trend line. Sits apart from the severity ramp on purpose.

tokens.name: threat-zeroday-soft
tokens.usage: Zero-day tag ground.

tokens.name: threat-kev
tokens.usage: CISA KEV tag and trend line; KEV items are weaponized, so they share the critical hue and carry a flame icon.

tokens.name: threat-ransomware
tokens.usage: Ransomware Threat tag and trend line, with a skull icon.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (blue) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (teal) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (amber) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (pink) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (lime) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical series 6 (slate) for non-severity dimensions (tool, team, subnet, scan batch). Use in order; never more than six series before grouping into 'Other'.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and zero-line ticks. Decorative; one step off the card ground.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis tick labels and legend text (12px `caption`).

tokens.name: chart-selected
tokens.usage: Outline of the cross-filtered chart mark (2px). Unselected marks drop to `opacity-dimmed`.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 0 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 1 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 2 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 3 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 4 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 5 (of 0–5) for density: subnet × month, aging buckets, the RACI matrix. Low → high runs dark → bright in dark themes and light → dark in light. Text on steps 1–2 is `ink`, on 4–5 `on-lens`; step 3 carries no text.

tokens.name: report-slate
tokens.usage: Executive Report "slate" theme: cover band and section header bars (default).

tokens.name: report-navy
tokens.usage: Executive Report "navy" theme header band.

tokens.name: report-crimson

tokens.name: on-report
tokens.usage: Text and the logo on any `report-*` band (≥ 10:1 on all three).

tokens.name: report-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and the accent underline under report section titles, on white paper.

fixed.note: Theme-independent colours: the report always prints on white paper.

tokens.name: on-avatar
tokens.usage: Initials on generated avatar hues; hsl(h 45% 32%) keeps every hue at or above 4.5:1.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: KPI and threat-index numbers. Plex Sans Condensed with tabular figures: narrow, tall, and it reads like an instrument readout.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: View titles and report section headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted SMB packets.
styles.usage: Descriptions, drawer prose, report narrative. 22px leading for reading.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, list rows, form inputs: the console's default density.

styles.name: body-strong

styles.name: card-title

styles.name: label

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Hosts, IPs, ports, CVE and plugin IDs, tickets. Turn on slashed zero (`font-feature-settings: "zero"`) so 0 and O never mix in IPs.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: IDs inside badges and chips, CVSS in dense lists.

scale.note: Primitive font sizes. Components use these through var(--text-*) or the semantic --type-* shorthands; raw px font sizes fail `npm run lint:tokens`.

tokens.name: text-2xs

tokens.name: text-sm

tokens.name: text-md

tokens.name: text-lg

tokens.name: text-xl

tokens.name: text-code

tokens.name: text-watermark

semantic.note: Font shorthands, one per style in `groups`. Use `font: var(--type-body-sm)`.

spacing.note: 4pt grid. Half steps (0.5, 1.5, 2.5) exist only for dense data UI; layout gaps use whole steps.

tokens.name: space-0.5

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-5

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-7

tokens.name: space-10

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: gap-section

tokens.name: gap-grid

tokens.name: gap-stack

tokens.name: gap-tight

tokens.name: inset-card

tokens.name: inset-card-end
tokens.usage: Card header end with actions.

tokens.name: inset-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal and drawer head, body, footer.

tokens.name: inset-cell
tokens.usage: Table cell sides.

radius.note: Concentric chain: an inner radius = outer radius minus the padding between them. Overlay 14 > card 10 > control 6 > badge 4 > mark 2.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Table cells, full-bleed bars, heat cells joined edge to edge.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chart bars (top corners), progress fills, focus marks, kbd inner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, chips, checkboxes, heatmap cells, kbd keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, KPI tiles, table wrappers, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-xl

tokens.name: radius-2xl

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, toggles, status dots.

tokens.name: radius-badge

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Alias: every interactive control.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Alias: resting containers.

tokens.name: radius-overlay
tokens.usage: Alias: floating layers.

shadow.note: Five-step elevation. Dark themes pair a 1px top highlight with layered negative-spread drops; light themes use cool-tinted soft layers; high-contrast swaps shadows for solid outlines.

tokens.name: shadow-xs

tokens.name: shadow-sm

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered tiles, sticky headers once scrolled, dragged items.

tokens.name: shadow-lg

tokens.name: shadow-xl

tokens.name: shadow-card

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Alias kept for compatibility → shadow-md.

tokens.name: shadow-popover

tokens.name: shadow-overlay

tokens.name: shadow-focus

tokens.name: ring-inset

tokens.name: ring-signal

composed.name: shadow-focus-soft

zIndex.note: Ladder spaced by 100 so local stacking (+1..+99) never crosses a layer. Always use a token; never a raw number above 9. The command palette, context menus and the bottom sheet reuse z-modal / z-popover.

breakpoint.note: Mobile-first. Use max-width: (bp - 1px) for down-only rules. Container queries preferred for cards.

tokens.name: bp-xs
tokens.usage: Small phones: single column, icon-only buttons.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Chips wrap to two lines; KPI row becomes 2-up.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: nav rail collapses to bottom bar; drawers go full width.

tokens.usage: Laptop: two-column grids collapse; side panels stack.

tokens.name: bp-xl

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Wide: content-max reached, extra columns on boards.

content.note: Dashboard-only content breakpoints used by legacy grid rules. Prefer container queries for new layouts; `npm run lint:tokens` rejects any other value.

motion.note: Short, purposeful. Everything collapses to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion.
